<DOCSTRING>
Logs the result of an operation.

Records the operation, its operands, and the result in the console for audit and debugging purposes.

@param {string} operation - The operation performed (e.g., "add", "subtract").
@param {number} a - The first operand.
@param {number} b - The second operand.
@param {number} result - The result of the operation.
</DOCSTRING>
